svg.title: Contact sheet: Mission analysis, links and space operations
svg.desc: One tile per scenario kind of the family Mission analysis, links and space operations, each the chart the engine writes for a bundled example of that kind, labelled with the kind and its ledger status: launch-window MODELLED; ascent-losses MODELLED; reentry MODELLED; entry-heating MODELLED 1 · VALIDATED 1; eo-coverage VALIDATED; eo-radiometry MODELLED; attitude-budget VALIDATED; aocs MODELLED 1 · VALIDATED 1; link-budget MODELLED 1 · VALIDATED 1; acm-link MODELLED; contact-schedule MODELLED; aperture-duty-cycle MODELLED; space-packet VALIDATED; oem-interop VALIDATED. Modelled results from stated inputs, not measurements. Advisory: not type-approved navigation equipment.
